description:
Mov Saga Online is an MMORPG based in virtual reality. Zerry has been a player since the game’s early days, yet he’s still stuck as a low-level novice. That’s because the idea of running through dungeons and completing quests has never interested him. He’d much rather stay cooped up in his virtual home, eating snacks all day. However, his gaming life takes a one-eighty when he suddenly stumbles upon a rare weapon that grants him exclusive access to an epic quest! With the encouragement and anticipation of his friend, Tana, Zerry finally begins leveling himself up to take on the challenge. But this epic quest will soon turn out to be much more than both players bargained for…

(Source: Tappytoon)
